requirement: 15–30% of outer plates removed along their seams, exposing the frame beneath. Source does not define area or projected coverage denominator.
classification: Body connected components, Hull/Accent only; polygon samples must be first visible hits from external sphere and front-facing. All orientations. Trim/Dark excluded from denominator. Hidden thickness excluded by first hit; exposed bevel edges retained.
method: Area weighted seeded uniform barycentric samples; normal plus 48 Fibonacci sphere directions, first eligible unoccluded direction. Same external ray against complete husked LOD0. Presence depth tolerances 2/5/10 cm.
caveats: Trim hit is a mechanical-material hit, not semantic proof of structural frame; dark backing never counted as frame.
Finite directional/sample convergence is an empirical sensitivity range, not a statistical confidence interval.
Disconnected components are candidate plates, not a proof each connected component is one authored panel.
Exposed bevel area retained; visible cavity lining can remain if Hull/Accent authored there. No visual PASS.
